task.description:
Hard gate — validate the TEST-DESIGNER's test spec for TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH.

Checks:
1. TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH is documented in tests/specs/VLD-04.md with full Given/When/Then.
2. TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH in tests/integration/vld04_gate_test.zig is runnable (no SkipZigTest on a MUST test).
3. The test fixture is isolated: per-test data only, no shared state that would cause non-determinism.
4. ISS-0717's acceptance criterion (PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id} returns 422 when gate fires) is fully covered.
5. The test is self-sufficient (can run standalone without other test files).

Return PASS if all checks pass, FAIL with specific list of gaps otherwise.

result.summary: TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH validated against all 5 checks. (1) Spec: Given/When/Then complete in tests/specs/VLD-04.md — fixture, call, and three assertions documented. (2) Runnable: no error.SkipZigTest; requireTestDbUrl returns hard MissingTestDbUrl error (not a silent skip). (3) Fixture isolation: seedDefinition generates per-test UUID-named rows; defer cleanup targets that UUID; no shared module state. (4) ISS-0717 coverage: handlePatch in src/api/routes/definitions.zig confirmed to call runSemanticGate and return HTTP 422 on .invalid; test asserts status_code==422, body non-empty, and DB semantically_valid=false. (5) Self-sufficient: own pool, own fixture, own cleanup, clear error on absent BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
